//overrides: qs: @stryker-mutator/core -> typed-rest-client@2.3.1 pins qs at EXACTLY 6.15.1, which carries GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26 (qs.stringify DoS). That exact pin — not a range — is why `npm audit fix` cannot resolve it without --force. The vulnerable path is unreachable here (typed-rest-client only serves Stryker's dashboard reporter, which stryker.config.mjs does not enable), but a knowingly-vulnerable dependency is not something we keep. Drop this override once typed-rest-client ships qs >= 6.15.2.
